images.title: 品牌主视觉 · 简化右下角
images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / text replacement. Edit this finished TowardsLight promotional image with one localized change to the LOWER-RIGHT area. Preserve the rest of the design.

REMOVE completely the lower-right white webpage screenshot panel containing a round profile avatar, Chinese author text, contact links and dense article cards. It occupies approximately x=946..1618, y=620..940 on this 1672 x 941 image. Remove all of that panel's content, white rectangular background, corner border and shadow. Do not leave any fragments or replace it with another screenshot.

In that vacated area, reconstruct a continuous, quiet background by naturally extending the surrounding native muted gray-green, warm taupe and pale peach/offwhite colors. Smoothly blend into the existing neighboring canvas; no visible rectangle or seam. Do NOT create a new card, plaque, panel, opaque text box, decorative illustration or independent background scene. The result should feel more open and less busy.

Place a simple editorial ENGLISH text block directly on this restored background in the lower right. Left-align at approximately x=990, beginning around y=665, with a comfortable right margin and plenty of breathing space above the bottom footer. Use these exact words:
Main heading: "Make it your own."
Supporting copy: "From personal notes"
"to long-form stories."
Small feature line: "Light & dark · Responsive · Built with Astro"

Use the SAME narrow upright bold sans-serif typeface appearance as the existing external "TowardsLight" headline at upper-left, with smoothly rounded letter bowls and firm straight stems, not octagonal/techno lettering. This new heading is secondary to the upper-left brand title: about 42–48px high, on one line, in dark warm charcoal for comfortable contrast against the light background. Supporting copy uses the existing neutral sans-serif body style, around 24px with relaxed line spacing. The feature line is quieter at about 15px, with ordinary case exactly as written. Do not add icons, bullet cards, dividers, badges or extra slogans. Keep the block compact enough that there is visible open space around it.

INVARIANTS: retain the upper-right large sunset homepage screenshot and its exact position/size, all its imagery and script brand lettering; retain the lower-left pale homepage screenshot and its position/size; retain all the left-hand external copy including the recently updated narrow bold white "TowardsLight" title; retain existing overall palette, background imagery outside the edit area, composition, shadows of the two retained screenshots and the flat style. Retain bottom-left signature "TOWARDSLIGHT" and the bottom-right "01 / 05" footer, restoring the latter cleanly if necessary. Do not add or move any screenshot. Preserve the 1672 x 941 landscape canvas. Only change the removed panel region into the described background and new text.

images.headline: One theme. A natural transition.
images.prompt:

Match that heading's actual narrow/condensed bold sans-serif letterforms: upright tall proportions, compact width, firm straight strokes, slightly squared oval counters, crisp terminals, strong but controlled weight. Use the same apparent typeface/family for the target's MAIN external headline. Apply its corresponding lowercase glyph style where the target uses lowercase. Preserve the target headline's exact capitalization; do NOT turn it into all caps. Do not copy the words ROOM TO READ, any pictures, background or layout from image 2.
Only change the font of the specified main external headline in image 1. Keep its original text verbatim, punctuation, number of lines, alignment, anchor position, font color and approximately the same cap height. Do not recolor, add effects, simplify, enhance or regenerate the whole image. Do not introduce new text. Keep the original 1672 x 941 canvas and flat design.
Target headline is the single large dark line near the TOP, approximately x=80..1000, y=109..164: "One theme. A natural transition." Match the reference heading's narrower bold type family while preserving this sentence case, full stop punctuation, single-line arrangement, top-left anchor and dark ink color. Preserve "LIGHT + DARK", the subtitle "Two modes, with a shared visual language.", both light/dark webpage screenshots and the dark olive navigation pill completely unchanged.

images.title: 斜向阅读拼贴
images.description: 「新的开始」蓝色封面、A-MEM 图解、编辑器介绍与深色标题层级，利用大小、角度和遮挡组织阅读内容。
images.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Output a polished landscape 16:9 raster campaign graphic for the TowardsLight Astro blog theme.
Design language: premium contemporary FLAT editorial graphic design. Introduce clear 2D rotations, asymmetry, unequal sizes, expressive edge cropping and meaningful overlaps. The screenshots are RECTANGULAR raster layers rotated IN THE CANVAS PLANE (about 5 to 12 degrees), never skewed into perspective. They have zero thickness and remain truly flat, no 3D camera, physical panels, desks, pedestals, device frames, phone hardware, bevels, paper texture or staged studio lighting. Allow a very faint soft shadow or fine boundary only where overlapping screenshot edges need definition. Design with intentional gaps and breathing space; do not line up screenshots in equal columns or one full-width horizontal row, and do not revert to an ordinary PowerPoint title band with content below.
Source fidelity: input screenshots are the actual visual content. Preserve their imagery, navigation appearance, Chinese typography, UI structure and native colors as faithfully as possible. Crop, scale and rotate, but do not redesign the actual UI, invent website elements or make raster text into random symbols. Keep meaningful screenshot titles and visuals visible despite overlap. Never use or recreate the personal homepage orange-cloud hero or script TowardsLight masthead; none are part of this image. No unrelated reference brands or invented logos.
Color continuity: derive ALL surrounding canvas color from the actual inputs, with subtle low-frequency edge-color expansion and seamlessly merging atmospheres. Light page white should grade into its own tinted background; darker inserts are surrounded by intermediate tones so there is no jarring black-white split. Do not impose a generic cream/gray stage or independently invented preset background. No artificial light sources, hard shadows, rays, neon blobs or massive vignette. Natural tonal depth may come from the sources' existing photographic/illustrated imagery.
Typography: modern clean bold sans serif, beautifully kerned, black/charcoal or pale neutral according to local background contrast. Small uppercase eyebrow, concise headline, one restrained line of explanatory English. Place external copy in an intentionally shaped negative-space pocket, not always a full-width top bar. All English copy must be exact as specified. No extra copy, fake badges, performance claims or watermarks. Small signature "TOWARDSLIGHT" lower-left and sequence number lower-right, anchored horizontally to the canvas.
Image 03 / 05: editorial reading collage. All four inputs are content sources: (1) blue architectural photo and essay "新的开始"; (2) A-MEM article with pale blue, lilac, apricot and mint flow diagram; (3) article showcasing the TowardsLight VS Code editor extension; (4) dark olive typography hierarchy article with amber headings.

Art direction: an asymmetric, diagonal reading scrapbook without any scrapbook props or paper material. Main essay window is LARGE at the left, rotated counterclockwise about 8 degrees, partly cut off by the left canvas boundary. Show its rich blue photographic cover, white Chinese heading, and a little of the essay body. The A-MEM flow-diagram crop overlaps its lower-right edge, rotated clockwise about 5 degrees, at a different scale, with its colorful diagram prominent. A smaller editor-extension article crop can enter from the bottom-right edge, with a short narrow dark-typography detail crop tucked under one edge as a dark accent. Vary each crop's aspect ratio meaningfully; do not make an evenly spaced row of four documents. The overlapping area should be visually convincing but very flat, with only a hairline or extremely subtle boundary. Every main visual must remain visible. Use confident big crops and leave a calm, clean upper-right pocket for headline rather than making every image equally tiny. Allow some pages to extend off-canvas. Do not put all bottoms or tops on the same baseline.

Color: the essay's own muted azure blue and the A-MEM graphic's pale blue/mint/lilac subtly spread into the negative space; the article whites gently connect them. The small olive article should darken only its local region. This plate should feel blue-silver and warm offwhite overall, naturally arising from its sources, not the orange sunset of the homepage.

Exact English copy in the upper-right negative-space pocket:
"ROOM TO READ"
"Ideas, in their own rhythm."
"Essays, research and the details between."
Footer "TOWARDSLIGHT" and "03 / 05".
Keep copy compact with elegant line breaks, not a horizontal banner. Finish as one cohesive, high-end, dynamic FLAT promotion.
